name: SOCCER RADAR v6.26 · QUALITY-FIRST MULTI-MARKET SELECTOR

parameters.content:
## SOCCER RADAR v6.26 · QUALITY-FIRST MULTI-MARKET SELECTOR

v6.25.4 (UNIFIED_HISTORY_FIRST) is retired as the production prediction engine. This is a from-scratch architecture: FIXTURE -> ALL MARKETS -> MODEL -> BET365 -> CALIBRATION -> QUALITY GATE -> MARKET RANKING -> BEST MARKET -> EXECUTION RECHECK -> PUBLICATION. Max 1 public Single per fixture. 0 signals is a valid result.

No reciprocal logic. No shadow bets (only a research dataset of every evaluated candidate). Asian Handicap is scored but never public (PUBLIC_ENABLED=false).

**Required n8n environment variables** (Settings -> Variables, never hard-coded):
- SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY
- SR626_PROVIDER_API_BASE, SR626_PROVIDER_API_KEY (5DollarFootballAPI PRO)
- SR626_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID

**Required credential**: a Telegram API credential named "Telegram account" (n8n Credentials, not hard-coded).

All thresholds live in lib/config.js CONFIG (bundled into every Code node) -- Scanner, Gate and Build all read the same numbers.
Collects real Bet365 prices only. No approximate price, no nearest-line fallback, no cross-market substitution. Writes sr_v626_market_snapshots.

Per fixture: builds the FixtureProfile, runs the Dixon-Coles goal model, scores all 49 markets, selects the best PUBLIC-enabled market, and applies the full quality gate + execution recheck before ever calling Telegram.
WIN/HALF_WIN/PUSH/HALF_LOSS/LOSS/VOID with settlement-aware Asian quarter-line splitting. Replies to the original Telegram post via its stored message_id.
Reads only sr_v626_picks (official public Singles). Rolling 7d/30-settled metrics only render once the sample is large enough.

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger: Market Scout 07:00/14:00/21:00
nodes.notes: Fires once per window (A/B/C). Fetches the fixture+odds universe for that window only -- no overlap with the other two windows (see lib/schedule.js getActiveWindow).

nodes.name: Code: Market Scout v6.26
nodes.notes: Fetches fixtures + real Bet365 prices for this window only, parses into the canonical payload, and stores one snapshot row per fixture. Never fetches Asian markets beyond what Bet365 actually quotes -- no synthetic lines.

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger: Selector 07:30/14:30/21:30
nodes.notes: Runs 30 minutes after its paired Market Scout window so every snapshot used here is fresh (well under the 55-minute staleness gate).

nodes.name: Code: Load Fixtures From Snapshots
nodes.notes: Reads back the latest snapshot per fixture (never re-fetches odds), pulls team history from the provider (rate-limited), and emits one item per executable fixture (kickoff >= 45min away).

nodes.name: Code: Evaluate + Persist Fixture
nodes.notes: Runs the full engine for ONE fixture, persists every candidate (approved or rejected) for the research dataset, and stages the fixture's best market (if any) for the publication queue. A failure here never stops the loop.

nodes.name: Code: Finalize Candidate Queue
nodes.notes: Sorts all of this run's best-market candidates by score, then enforces the run cap, the daily cap, and fixture dedup against sr_v626_publication_registry. 0 approved candidates is a perfectly valid outcome.

nodes.name: Code: Execution Recheck
nodes.notes: Reloads the live price for the EXACT fixture/market/line right before publishing and re-runs the full gate. Fails closed on any mismatch, staleness, or price deterioration > 2%. Never falls back to a nearby line, another market, or a stale price.

nodes.name: Code: Build Pick + Insert
nodes.notes: Only reaches sr_v626_picks after both the own-candidate gate AND the execution recheck passed.

nodes.name: Code: Record Telegram Failure
nodes.notes: Telegram publish failed. The pick row is marked TELEGRAM_FAILED (never silently lost, never double-published on retry).

nodes.name: Code: Save Run Diagnostics
nodes.notes: Every Selector run ends here, published or not. This is the single row an operator reads to see exactly what happened this run.

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger: Settlement :15/:45
nodes.notes: Settles finished fixtures and opportunistically captures the closing line for picks whose kickoff has just passed.

nodes.name: Code: Fetch Result + Settle
nodes.notes: Fail-soft: a provider error or an unfinished fixture defers this pick to the next run without throwing. Asian quarter-line settlement (WIN/HALF_WIN/PUSH/HALF_LOSS/LOSS/VOID) is mathematically exact.

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger: Daily Report 08:00
nodes.notes: Reports only on sr_v626_picks (official public Singles) -- the research-only market_candidates table never feeds this report.
